event.summary: Switchboard announced a full wind-down. All implementations are deprecated immediately and remaining support ends 2026-09-25. Solana protocols reported as Switchboard integrators include Kamino, Jito, MarginFi, and Drift; Switchboard recommends migration to Pyth or RedStone.
event.why_meaningful: This is a forced oracle-provider leadership rotation, not a points/airdrop/yield-farming flow. It creates an operational migration risk for major Solana DeFi protocols and a potential market-share catalyst for Pyth/RedStone. It is not yet proof of discretionary speculative capital migrating into PYTH.

solana_context.interpretation: Solana is not currently showing a broad spot/stablecoin discretionary-inflow regime. Gross stablecoin mint headlines should not override the observed 7d stablecoin contraction without evidence the newly minted inventory is actually deployed.

affected_protocol_context.caveat: These TVL figures must not be interpreted as $2.917B of capital at risk or as exclusively dependent on Switchboard; they only show that the migration touches large protocols.

pyth_fundamentals.strategic_reserve: OP-PIP-87 established market purchases of PYTH from DAO treasury/revenue; August report records 669,661.722734 PYTH purchased and returned to DAO treasury.
pyth_fundamentals.ois_incentives: Oracle Integrity Staking rewards were set to zero on 2026-04-22; staking/slashing remains active.
pyth_fundamentals.value_capture_quality: Real but governance-mediated: revenues can fund strategic-reserve PYTH purchases. PYTH is not directly required as the payment token for data consumption, and the newer V2 proposal is not treated as implemented unless passed.

wallet_quality.reason: No fresh independently funded, historically selective PYTH spot-accumulator cohort was verified in this run. Recent holder-growth/technical reports do not satisfy the selective-wallet standard.

positive: Third-party Solana token inspection reports mint authority revoked.
Third-party Solana token inspection reports freeze authority revoked.
unresolved_or_caveat: Raw top-10 address concentration is reported near 48%, but beneficial-owner composition and linked-wallet independence were not resolved in this run.
A large scheduled unlock remains in May 2027; not near-term, but material to medium-term dilution.
No deployer/funding-lineage analysis sufficient to clear all concentration/linkage gates was completed this run.

leadership_assessment.reason: Switchboard's exit forces real infrastructure migration and names Pyth/RedStone as replacements, while Pyth already has commercial revenue and dominant reported RWA-perp pricing coverage. But the actual destination split is not yet observed, PYTH spot volume is lower day/day, and selective-wallet confirmation is absent.

existing_paper_position_impact.reason: Solana's Switchboard implementation was not implicated in the August Move-chain compromise, and established alternatives exist. The six-day migration window is nevertheless an ecosystem operational-risk checkpoint.

forward_tests: Before/at 2026-09-25, verify which of Kamino, Jito, MarginFi and Drift actually migrate to Pyth, RedStone, another oracle, or a hybrid design.
Measure whether Pyth gains fee-paying usage/revenue rather than only integrations or narrative attention.
Require renewed PYTH spot-volume/liquidity growth plus independently funded selective-wallet accumulation before any paper starter.
Resolve beneficial-owner concentration and wallet-linkage questions before clearing the structural gate for a buy.
Watch for migration incidents, stale-price/oracle failures, pauses or liquidations that would worsen the SOL ecosystem-risk case.
Do not classify gross Solana USDC/USDT treasury mints as capital inflow unless net circulating balances/deployment confirm it.
no_hindsight: This record was written prospectively before any future protocol migration outcome or paper action.
